title: Exporting Models with torch.export knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “Exporting a model using example inputs” in this lesson?
options: This topic makes every serialized checkpoint safe to load from an unknown source.
Define the artifact/input/output contract and verify it end-to-end, including invalid input, runtime compatibility, and useful failure responses.
This topic removes the need to validate inputs or inspect model outputs.
This topic guarantees identical results across all devices and package versions.
questions.answer_key: Define the artifact/input/output contract and verify it end-to-end, including invalid input, runtime compatibility, and useful failure responses.
questions.explanation: Exporting a model using example inputs: Define the artifact/input/output contract and verify it end-to-end, including invalid input, runtime compatibility, and useful failure responses.

questions.prompt: Before relying on “Understanding ExportedProgram”, what should a learner verify?
options: confirm evaluation/inference mode, input validation, output postprocessing, versioned artifacts, and eager-versus-exported output agreement.
Assume all tensor dimensions and devices are interchangeable without checking them.
Use the held-out test split repeatedly to tune the model and report that score as unbiased.
Skip recording package versions because they cannot affect API or device behavior.
questions.answer_key: confirm evaluation/inference mode, input validation, output postprocessing, versioned artifacts, and eager-versus-exported output agreement.
questions.explanation: This lesson recommends the following check: confirm evaluation/inference mode, input validation, output postprocessing, versioned artifacts, and eager-versus-exported output agreement.

questions.prompt: Which pitfall matters when applying “Export constraints and control flow”?
options: Change several unrelated settings at once and infer which change fixed the result.
Treat successful imports as proof that the full model and evaluation pipeline are correct.
Catch every exception and silently replace failed results with zeros.
Do not expose arbitrary file loading or accept unlimited request sizes in an inference endpoint.
questions.answer_key: Do not expose arbitrary file loading or accept unlimited request sizes in an inference endpoint.
questions.explanation: This topic-specific caution is important: Do not expose arbitrary file loading or accept unlimited request sizes in an inference endpoint.
